name: audit_queue_status_20261104
comment: ANCHOR: AUDIT_QUEUE_STATUS_20261104 — the audit fix queue's status field follows GitHub rather than memory
(AuditFixQueueStatusRules@v1, authored cc-deepseek-3, adopted 2026-11-04). An open PR naming a row moves it to
fix_in_review with its head; a merged PR marks it delivered with the merge commit; a PR closed without merging parks
it. HELD_*, delivered, parked and closed_* rows are decisions and are never overwritten. Dry run by default;
--apply backs the queue up first. Hermetic: a queue document and PR dicts, gh never runs.
